title: OIL FILLER, LEVEL GAGE & FILTER
summary: Engine oil system on the small-block: oil level gage (dipstick) in its tube on the right side of the block, oil filter adapter bolted to the block boss, and the spin-on oil filter. The adapter is held by bolts [4]; the filter spins onto the adapter's threaded center nipple (no separate stud) and is hand-tightened slowly so the gasket isn't damaged. Engine oil fill is at the valve cover filler opening.

fastening.note: Bolts [4] go up through the adapter [3] ears into the block; dashed lines show two bolt holes.
Filter [5] threads onto the adapter's own threaded center nipple (no separate stud/callout). Oil [7b] on the gasket; tighten slowly (see CAUTION).
Dipstick tube [2] inserted into the block hole beside the exhaust manifold; no fastener shown.
Gage [1] slides into the top of tube [2].

notes: CAUTION: Slow take-up for compression of gasket is necessary to prevent damage to gasket, over torquing will rupture filter can.
